snippet.title: Dreams on a Pillow - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Dreams on a Pillow, a 2D puzzle platformer developed by Rasheed Abueideh. Players will explore a folk tale based on true events of the Palestinian Nakba of 1948. Explore a woman's journey to escape a massacre with themes of invasion and perceptual distortion. Master stealth in Dreams on a Pillow, coming soon to PC (Steam).
